children.text: This guide covers active strategies and rotations for the Rex Matriarchs. There are two main strategies:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Higher KPH at the cost of significantly higher effort
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only applies to Rathis/Orikalka/Pthentraken (Osseous has a separate arena)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Simpler and uses only 1 combat style at the cost of lower KPH
Alternate between a pair of Matriarchs to minimise wasted time during respawns. It is suggested to follow the rotations listed for each boss in the below section
⬥ If killing Rathis, you can target Rathis from range while moving towards her, and use defensives to build 100% adrenaline for your opening
⬥ If killing Rathis/Pthentraken, ensure you travel at the edge of the arena to prevent aggression from Orikalka
